title: Monthly Transactions Summary
scenario: Find for each month and country, the total number of transactions, total amount, number of approved transactions, and total approved amount. Return the result table as 'month', 'country', 'trans_count', 'approved_count', 'trans_total_amount', and 'approved_total_amount'.
tableSchema: transactions (id INT, country VARCHAR, state VARCHAR, amount INT, trans_date DATE)
hint: Use STRFTIME('%Y-%m', trans_date) to group by month and SUM(CASE WHEN state = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) for counts.
correctQuery: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', trans_date) AS month, country, COUNT(*) AS trans_count, SUM(CASE WHEN state = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_count, SUM(amount) AS trans_total_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN state = 'approved' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS approved_total_amount FROM transactions GROUP BY month, country;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE transactions (id INT, country VARCHAR, state VARCHAR, amount INT, trans_date DATE); INSERT INTO transactions VALUES (121, 'US', 'approved', 1000, '2018-12-18'), (122, 'US', 'declined', 2000, '2018-12-19'), (123, 'US', 'approved', 2000, '2019-01-01');
